nature
大自然
Where could you enjoy nature without travelling far from home?
I could enjoy nature along the stream near my apartment. Watching birds there would make a short walk feel like a real break.
我家附近的溪邊，就能親近大自然。在那裡看看鳥，短短散步也像真正休息了一下。
climate
氣候
How would a different climate affect your choice of a place to live?
I would consider how the climate affects daily travel and housing. A place I enjoy visiting might feel different all year round.
我會考慮氣候怎麼影響通勤和居住。短暫旅行喜歡的地方，不一定適合住一整年。
pollution
污染
What sign of pollution would you report in your neighbourhood?
I would report unusual pollution in a stream, including its location and time. Photos taken safely could help the relevant team investigate.
看到溪流有異常污染，我會記下地點和時間通報。安全拍下的照片，也能幫忙調查。
recycle
回收
How would you help visitors recycle correctly in a shared building?
I would label the bins with examples of what to recycle. Clear pictures could be easier to follow than a long list.
我會在回收桶標示可以回收的東西。清楚的圖片，可能比長篇清單容易看懂。
reduce
減少
What disposable item could you reduce using during a normal week?
I could reduce the number of takeaway cups I use. Keeping a reusable cup beside my bag would remind me to bring it.
我可以減少外帶杯的使用。把環保杯放在包包旁邊，就比較不會忘記帶。
plastic
塑膠
How would you shop if you wanted to use less plastic?
I would bring containers for items usually wrapped in plastic. I would focus on a few repeat purchases rather than expect immediate perfection.
我會自備容器，裝平常用塑膠包裝的商品。先從常買的幾樣改起，不求一下子全做到。
package
包裝
You receive a small item in an enormous package. What could you tell the seller?
I would ask whether a smaller package was available for future orders. The item could still be protected without so much empty space.
我會問賣家，以後能不能用小一點的包裝。保護好商品，不一定需要留那麼多空間。
resource
資源
Which shared resource should your neighbourhood look after more carefully?
The local water supply is a shared resource worth protecting. I would report leaks instead of assuming someone else had noticed them.
自來水是值得一起珍惜的資源。看到漏水，我會通報，不假設已經有人處理。
protect
保護
How could a hiking group protect a place it enjoys visiting?
The group could protect the trail by staying on marked paths. We would take our rubbish home instead of leaving it beside full bins.
我們可以沿標示路徑走，保護喜歡的步道。垃圾桶滿了，就把垃圾帶回家，不堆在旁邊。
conserve
節省
What would help people conserve water in a shared garden?
We could conserve water by checking the soil before watering. Fixing a leaking hose would also avoid waste without harming the plants.
澆水前先看看土壤，就能節省用水。修好漏水的水管，也不會影響植物照顧。
forest
森林
What would you want to know before walking in an unfamiliar forest?
I would check the forest trail's difficulty and closing time. I would also tell someone where I planned to walk.
進陌生森林前，我會查步道難度和關閉時間。也告訴別人，自己打算走哪裡。
river
河流
How could a riverside path serve both walkers and wildlife?
The path could keep some space between people and the river. Quiet sections without bright lights would leave wildlife less disturbed.
步道可以和河流留一點距離。部分區段保持安靜、不設強光，減少對野生動物的打擾。
ocean
海洋
What would you like to understand better about the ocean?
I would like to understand how ocean habitats connect with coastal towns. That could make local conservation choices easier to discuss.
我想多了解海洋棲地和沿海城鎮的關係。討論當地保育選擇時，就能有更多理解。
coast
海岸
What would make a visit to the coast enjoyable without disturbing the area?
I would visit a public path along the coast and keep my distance from nesting birds. A quiet visit can still be memorable.
我會沿海岸的公共步道走，和築巢的鳥保持距離。安靜地參觀，也能留下好回憶。
weather
天氣
Your outdoor plans depend on the weather. How would you keep the day enjoyable?
I would check the weather and prepare an indoor alternative. We could change the activity without cancelling the chance to meet.
我會先看天氣，也準備室內備案。活動能調整，不必連見面的機會都取消。
storm
暴風雨
A storm is expected during your planned outing. How would you decide what to do?
I would check official warnings before the storm arrived. Postponing the outing would be easier than dealing with unsafe conditions on the road.
暴風雨來之前，我會先查官方警報。延後出遊，總比在路上遇到危險狀況容易處理。
flood
淹水
What information would you want before returning to an area after a flood?
After a flood, I would check official information about road access and safety. I would not assume a familiar route was usable.
淹水後，我會先查官方的道路和安全資訊。熟悉的路線，也不能直接假設還能通行。
drought
乾旱
How might a community respond fairly during a drought?
During a drought, restrictions should be clearly explained and applied fairly. People would also need practical information about saving water.
乾旱期間，限制措施應該說明清楚，也公平執行。大家也需要實際的節水資訊。
temperature
溫度
How would you choose an outdoor activity on a day with a high temperature?
I would check the temperature before choosing the time and place. A shaded morning walk might be more comfortable than an exposed afternoon route.
我會先看溫度，再選時間和地點。早上走有樹蔭的路，可能比下午曝曬舒服。
wildlife
野生動物
What would you do if wildlife approached your picnic area?
I would give the wildlife space and secure our food. Feeding an animal for a photo would not be part of the outing.
我會和野生動物保持距離，把食物收好。不會為了拍照，就拿東西餵牠。
habitat
棲息地
Why might a small patch of untidy land be worth keeping as a habitat?
That habitat might shelter insects and small animals. I would want to know what lives there before replacing it with paving.
那片棲息地可能讓昆蟲和小動物躲藏。鋪成水泥地前，我想先了解裡面住著什麼。
species
物種
How would you learn the name of an unfamiliar species without disturbing it?
I would photograph the species from a distance and consult a field guide. I would leave it where it was rather than collect it.
我會從遠處拍下這個物種，再查圖鑑。不帶走牠，讓牠留在原來的地方。
transport
交通工具
What would help you use public transport more often?
Reliable public transport in the evening would help me most. A useful route home matters as much as the morning journey.
晚間有可靠的公共交通工具，對我最有幫助。回家的路，和早上出門一樣重要。
carbon
碳
What would you ask about a product advertised as low in carbon emissions?
I would ask how its carbon emissions were measured. A clear comparison would help me understand the claim better than a green label alone.
我會問產品的碳排放怎麼計算。清楚的比較，比只貼綠色標籤更能讓我理解。
